prerequisites.text: Buy a current-year qualifying license (e.g., annual small game or spring turkey) before applying, including for a point only. It can be in the same cart but must be added first.
prerequisites.quote: A current-year qualifying license is required for all hunters (including youth hunters) to apply for the big game primary and secondary draws, including applicants who are applying for a preference point as a first-choice.

prerequisites.text: Hunter education card required if born on or after Jan. 1, 1949.
prerequisites.quote: individuals born on or after January 1, 1949, must complete an approved hunter education course before applying for or purchasing a Colorado hunting license.
have purchased a qualifying license and a habitat (required for ages 18 to 64 only) before they can apply.

prerequisites.text: Social Security or Taxpayer ID number required for age 12+, plus valid ID.
prerequisites.quote: A Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number is required for hunters age 12 and older, per federal law.

prerequisites.text: Must be at least 12 to hunt big game. A card must be on file; drawn licenses are charged automatically.
prerequisites.quote: Hunters who wish to participate in the primary draw must be at least 12 years old to hunt big game.

notes: CPW has not posted 2027 draw dates (checked 2026-11-04; the brochure usually comes out in February), so all dates are the 2026 cycle, marked last_year. The 'Application Deadlines' widget on the primary-draw page showed 'No Results'. A CPW regulation-change document says the regular-draw deadline is 8 p.m. MT on the first Tuesday in April. That would be April 6, 2027, but CPW has not announced it, so it is not recorded above. 2026 payment deadlines were 11:59 p.m. MT on June 12 (primary), July 21 (secondary) and May 7 (sheep/goat). Bear and bison are in the same draw but outside this file's scope. Desert bighorn sheep do not earn preference points. The CPW qualifying-license web page lists different, unlabeled amounts ($35.76, $183.94, etc.) that look like an older schedule; the fees above come from the 2026 brochures. CPW adjusts fees with CPI each year, so 2027 amounts will change.
